managerOverrides.outcomeNote: The manager selected Wissa from a model-classified near tie instead of the roll default; Wissa played 90 minutes but scored two fewer points than Calvert-Lewin.

lessons: Official FPL marks GW5 finished and data-checked. The submitted team scored 65 points, 17 above the 48-point average, and improved overall rank from 3,647,848 to 2,196,443.
The public transfer, starting XI, captain, vice-captain and bench order exactly match the saved pre-deadline submission plan.

The model-default roll would have retained Calvert-Lewin and scored 67 points. The manager-selected Wissa transfer scored 65, a two-point realized override cost inside a pre-deadline 0.45-point expected-value near tie.
Wissa played 90 minutes but scored zero, so the transfer miss was attacking-output variance rather than an availability or starting-role failure.

Barry scored six and would have beaten Wissa by six points, but his pre-deadline projection depended on asymmetric market coverage. That realized result is a review signal, not evidence that the alternative was decision-grade.
Haaland captaincy added six points. Switching the armband to submitted vice-captain Mbeumo would have reduced the total by four points.

The bench held 17 points from Verbruggen, Le Fee and Kayode, but every starter appeared and no automatic substitution was available. Kayode over Maguire or Le Fee over Mbeumo would only be hindsight gains.
The submitted team scored 65 against a 75.6-point expectation. Semenyo and Buendia substantially outperformed, while Mbeumo, Gabriel, Calafiori and Wissa produced the largest negative errors.

GW5 has no frozen archive, active-decision manifest or valid generated decision record. The public submission and pre-deadline shortlist support this manual comparison, but a decision-grade regret report is not reproducible.
